item.title: Iran vows revenge after the killing of its top leader and trades strikes with Israel in widening war
item.description: Iran has vowed revenge after the killing of its supreme leader.

item.title: Large fire rips through home in Lincolnwood, officials say
item.description: Fire crews arrived to find the garage fully ablaze as flames spread through the roof and into the back of the house.

item.title: New off-premise liquor tax takes effect in Chicago after postponement
item.description: A change took effect for taxes paid on liquor purchased at stores. The city of Chicago is requiring retailers to collect a 1.5% tax on those alcohol sales.

item.title: Amazon investigating after Elgin disabled senior inundated with over 100 packages she didn't order
item.description: An Amazon driver came by to get all of the packages from Pat Hurley's home on Saturday afternoon, and the company told ABC7 it apologized to her.

item.title: Vehicle crashes into garage in Chicago's West Lawn neighborhood
item.description: As the SUV was being towed out of the structure, bricks came crumbling down.

item.title: 2026 Polar Plunge Chicago: Many brave frigid Lake Michigan, raise over $1.5M for Special Olympics
item.description: Thousands braved the cold waters of Lake Michigan for this year's Polar Plunge Chicago, raising more than $1.5 million for Special Olympics Illinois.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara wins posthumous Actor Award for 'The Studio'; Seth Rogan accepts on her behalf
item.description: A month after her unexpected death, Catherine O'Hara won a posthumous award at the 32nd Actor Awards for her performance on "The Studio." Seth Rogan accepted on her behalf, saying O'Hara "showed that you could be a genius and you could be kind."

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Oil prices rose sharply when market trading began Sunday, as U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran and retaliatory strikes against Israel and U.S. military installations around the Gulf sent disruptions through the global energy supply chain.

item.title: 2 men shot, 1 fatally, outside bar in Morris, police say
item.description: A man was killed and another was injured in a shooting outside of a bar in Grundy County, officials said.

item.title: Man missing after being dropped off at O'Hare airport, did not board flight to France, family says
item.description: Chicago police are searching for a 23-year-old man who went missing after visiting his father. Elijah Hoard was dropped off at O'Hare airport on Friday, but his family says he never got on his flight to France.
